Description:
*As an airline admin*
I want to add/update/delete flight schedules
So that search results stay accurate

*Acceptance Criteria*

* CRUD operations work
* Deleted schedules not shown in search

*As a super admin*
I want to map users to airlines
So that they can manage flights

*Acceptance Criteria*

* airline_user mapping created

*As a user*
I want to cancel my booking
So that I can change plans

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Only owner can cancel
* Status becomes {{CANCELLED}}

*As a user*
I want to reschedule my booking
So that I can travel on another date

*Acceptance Criteria*

* New valid schedule selected
* Booking updated successfully

*As a user*
I want my ticket emailed
So that I can access it anytime

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Email sending simulated
* Success message shown

*As a user*
I want to download or print my ticket
So that I can keep a copy

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Printable or downloadable format available

*As a user*
I want my ticket generated
So that I can use it for travel

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Ticket includes booking ref, passengers, seats, flight details

*As a user*
I want to see payment status
So that I know my booking state

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Payment status visible in booking view

*As a user*
I want to pay using card
So that my booking is confirmed

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Credit / Debit card supported
* Payment status SUCCESS / FAILED (mock)
* Booking status updated accordingly

*As a user*
I want to add baggage quantity
So that extra baggage cost can be calculated

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Baggage quantity ≥ 0
* Stored per passenger

*As a user*
I want to assign seats
So that each passenger has a seat

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Same seat cannot be assigned twice in one booking
* Seat saved with passenger

*As a user*
I want to view seat availability
So that I can choose seats

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Seat map loaded from flight model
* Selected seats shown as unavailable

*As a user*
I want to add passenger details
So that the booking has traveler information

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Required passenger fields validated
* Passenger linked to booking

*As a user*
I want to see all my bookings
So that I can manage them

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Only user’s bookings shown
* Sorted by booking time or travel date

*As a user*
I want to view my booking
So that I can confirm travel details

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Only booking owner can view
* Shows flight, route, date, status

*As a logged-in user*
I want to create a booking
So that I can reserve a selected flight

*Acceptance Criteria*

* User must be logged in
* Booking created with status {{PENDING}}
* Booking reference generated

*As a user*
I want to view flight details
So that I can decide before booking

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Shows airline, route, date, time, model
* Data matches selected schedule

*As a user*
I want to search return flights
So that I can plan a round trip

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Return date ≥ departure date
* Outbound and return flights displayed

*As a user*
I want to search one-way flights
So that I can see available flights across airlines

*Acceptance Criteria*

* From, to, date are mandatory
* Results include airline, flight code, time
* Message shown if no flights available

*As a user*
I want to update my profile
So that my details stay current

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Profile fields updated successfully
* Changes persist after reload

*As a user*
I want to log out
So that my session is secure

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Session / token invalidated
* User redirected to login

*As a user*
I want to log in
So that I can access booking features

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Valid credentials allow login
* Invalid credentials show error
* Session / token created

*As a user*
I want to create an account
So that I can book flights

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Email is unique
* Required fields validated
* User account created successfully

*As a developer*
I want to prepopulate master data
So that search and booking can be tested immediately

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Airlines, destinations, routes created
* Flight models with seat mapping added
* Flights and flight schedules seeded
* Data visible via DB queries / APIs
Parent summary: Epic 0: Project Setup, Research & Agile Planning

Description:
*As a developer*
I want database migrations
So that the schema can be created consistently across environments

*Acceptance Criteria*

* All tables are created successfully
* One command sets up the schema from scratch
Parent summary: Epic 0: Project Setup, Research & Agile Planning
